appearance.title: Anna
appearance.visualDescription: Young woman with short black hair and brown eyes. She wears a bright red sweater and white sneakers.

pages.bio: Hi! I am Anna. I am 22 years old. I am tall. I have short black hair and brown eyes. I wear a bright red sweater, blue jeans, and white shoes.
I wake up early every morning. I drink milk and eat fresh apples. I walk in the park with my dog. I like happy music!
I love sunny summer days and fruit ice cream. I do not like rainy days or cold tea. I want to meet friendly people!

appearance.opener: Hello! I am Anna. Do you like red sweaters or blue jeans?
appearance.prompt: Describe Anna. What color is her hair? What clothes does she wear?

appearance.title: Marco
appearance.visualDescription: Tall young man with curly brown hair, green eyes, and black glasses. He wears a green t-shirt and blue denim jacket.

pages.bio: Hello! I am Marco, 25 years old. I am short and active. I have brown curly hair and green eyes. I wear a navy jacket and dark blue jeans.
I work in a small shop. I ride my yellow bicycle to work. I play soccer with my friends on Saturdays. I am very fast!

appearance.opener: Hi! Do you wear glasses or have curly hair?
appearance.prompt: What color are Marco's eyes and hair? Does he wear glasses?

professions.title: Chef John
professions.visualDescription: Man in a white hat and apron. He makes fresh bread and cakes in a bakery.

pages.bio: I am Chef John. I wear a clean white chef coat and a tall white hat. I work in a busy kitchen. I have short brown hair and a friendly face.
I cook hot soup and fresh bread every morning. I love good food! I make sweet cakes for birthday parties.
Good food makes people happy. I use fresh vegetables and clean water. I like eating meals with good friends!

professions.opener: Good morning! Do you like fresh bread or sweet cake?
professions.prompt: What does Chef John make every morning? Is his job early or late?

professions.title: Dr. Sarah
professions.visualDescription: Doctor wearing a white coat and blue stethoscope in a bright clinic.

pages.bio: I am Dr. Sarah, 29 years old. I wear a white doctor coat and carry a stethoscope. I have long brown hair tied in a pony tail.
I help sick people get healthy. I check heartbeats and give helpful advice. I work at a big city hospital every day.

professions.opener: Hello! How are you today? Do you feel good?
professions.prompt: Where does Dr. Sarah work? What clothes does she wear?

properties.title: Leo
properties.visualDescription: Owner of a cozy studio flat with a big sunny window, yellow sofa, and small kitchen.

pages.bio: Hi, I am Leo! I live in a cozy studio flat. It has one bright room, a red sofa, a small wooden table, and a big window.
I read books on my red sofa. I cook simple pasta in my small kitchen. My flat is quiet and near a metro station.
A good home is warm and simple. I like green plants and soft lights. I want a peaceful place to rest after work.

properties.opener: Welcome! Do you like small cozy flats or big houses?
properties.prompt: Name 3 things inside Leo's studio flat using simple words.

character.title: Mia
character.visualDescription: Smiling young person holding a warm cup of cocoa.

pages.bio: Hi, I am Mia! I am a kind and friendly person. I have short blonde hair, blue eyes, and a warm smile for everyone.
I love helping my friends. I help my neighbors carry heavy groceries. I share my umbrellas when it rains.

character.opener: Hello my friend! How are you today?
character.prompt: What does Mia do as a kind person? Describe 2 simple actions.

hobbies.title: Oliver
hobbies.visualDescription: Red bicycle parked near a green tree in a park.

pages.bio: I am Oliver, 26. My favorite hobby is cycling in the park! I wear a blue bicycle helmet and bright sports shoes.
I ride my bike for one hour every evening. I see green trees and birds in the park. It makes me feel happy and strong.
I want to ride my bike near the ocean one day. I like fresh air, sunshine, and active weekends with good friends!
redFlags: ✗ Wakes up at 6 AM on Sundays

hobbies.opener: Hello! Can you ride a bicycle? Do you ride in the park?
icebreakers: No, but I want to learn!
hobbies.prompt: Where does Oliver like to ride his bicycle?

nationalities.title: Kenji
nationalities.visualDescription: Young Japanese man with neat short dark hair, wearing a traditional yukata.

pages.bio: Konnichiwa! I am Kenji from Tokyo, Japan. I have short straight dark hair and brown eyes. I wear dark blue clothes and clean white sneakers.
I live near Shibuya in Tokyo. I ride fast trains to work. I eat hot ramen noodles and green tea ice cream.

nationalities.opener: Konnichiwa! What is your nationality? Where are you from?
nationalities.prompt: What is Kenji's nationality and home country? What food does he eat?

nationalities.title: Sofia
nationalities.visualDescription: Italian woman with brown wavy hair in Rome.

pages.bio: Ciao! I am Sofia from Rome, Italy. I have long dark wavy hair and brown eyes. I love colorful summer dresses and sunglasses.
In Rome, I drink espresso coffee at small cafes. I walk near historical fountains and talk with my family every evening.
My grandmother teaches me how to cook fresh pasta. I love hot pizza with basil and cheese. Eating together is important!

nationalities.opener: Ciao! Do you like Italian pizza or sweet gelato?
nationalities.prompt: Where is Sofia from? What is her nationality and native food?

food.title: Marco
food.visualDescription: Friendly Italian chef wearing a crisp white apron and holding a freshly baked Margherita pizza.

pages.bio: Hi! I am Marco. I love Italian food. I make fresh pizza and hot pasta every day. Tomato sauce and cheese are my favorite ingredients!
Every morning I bake fresh bread. The kitchen smells wonderful. I drink hot espresso and eat bread with butter.
In the evening, I eat dinner with friends. We share big bowls of spaghetti. Cooking for people makes me very happy!

food.opener: Hello! Do you like pizza or pasta for dinner?
food.prompt: Describe Marco's favorite foods and cooking routine using simple words.

food.title: Kenji
food.visualDescription: Young man at a noodle stall holding a bowl of steaming ramen with green onions and eggs.

pages.bio: Hello! I am Kenji. I eat hot ramen noodles every week. I like warm soup, green onions, and fresh eggs in my bowl.
After lunch, I drink hot green tea. It is fresh and healthy. I do not add sugar or milk to my tea.
On weekends, I make simple rice rolls with cucumber and salmon. Fresh fish and rice make a great lunch snack!

food.opener: Hi! Do you prefer hot ramen soup or fresh sushi rolls?
food.prompt: Talk about Kenji's favorite Japanese dishes and tea habits.

travel.title: Lucas
travel.visualDescription: Relaxed traveler wearing a sun hat and sunglasses on a bright sandy beach with turquoise blue ocean water.

pages.bio: Hi! I am Lucas. I love warm sunny beaches! I swim in the blue sea and walk on white sand. Summer is my favorite time to travel.
redFlags: ✗ Sleeps on the beach all day

pages.bio: I take one small bag when I travel. I pack t-shirts, shorts, and sunglasses. Traveling light makes moving easy and fast!
On holiday, I eat sweet ice cream and drink cold coconut water. Sitting near the ocean waves makes me feel happy and calm.

travel.opener: Hello! Do you like sunny beach holidays or cold mountain trips?
travel.prompt: Describe Lucas's beach vacation habits using simple A0-A1 vocabulary.

travel.title: Sophia
travel.visualDescription: Cheerful traveler holding a camera and map in front of an ancient castle on a cobblestone street.

pages.bio: Hello! I am Sophia. I visit old European cities. I like looking at tall castles, old bridges, and beautiful street lamps.
I carry a small camera everywhere. I take pictures of old buildings, colorful flowers, and happy people in the town square.
I read paper maps and walk through narrow streets. I like finding small local bakeries and buying fresh fruit juice.

travel.opener: Hi! Do you like taking photos of castles or reading travel maps?
travel.prompt: Talk about Sophia's city tours and photography habits in basic English.

entertainment.title: Maya
entertainment.visualDescription: Happy movie fan holding a large bucket of popcorn inside a brightly lit movie theater.
entertainment.anthem: 🎵 'Can't Stop the Feeling!' by Justin Timberlake

pages.bio: Hi! I am Maya. I love watching movies at the cinema! Animated films and funny comedies make me laugh. Popcorn is my favorite movie snack.
I listen to pop music on my headphones every day. I sing sweet songs while I clean my room or walk to school.
In the evening, I read colorful comic books and graphic novels. The big pictures help me learn new stories easily.

entertainment.opener: Hello! Do you like watching animated movies or reading comic books?
entertainment.prompt: Describe Maya's entertainment habits, favorite movie snacks, and musical taste.

entertainment.title: Leo
entertainment.visualDescription: Young musician smiling while playing an acoustic guitar on a wooden bench.

pages.bio: Hello! I am Leo. I play the acoustic guitar. I know many simple songs. Playing music for my friends makes me very happy!
I turn on the radio every morning. I like listening to old rock music and catchy pop radio hits while drinking tea.
On Sunday afternoons, I watch fun action movies on TV. Fast cars, superheroes, and big explosions are exciting!

entertainment.opener: Hi! Do you play a musical instrument or listen to the radio?
entertainment.prompt: Talk about Leo's guitar playing, musical preferences, and Sunday movie choices.

daily_habits.title: Emma
daily_habits.visualDescription: Bright early riser smiling with a cup of morning tea beside an open sunlit window.
daily_habits.anthem: 🎵 'Here Comes the Sun' by The Beatles

pages.bio: Hi! I am Emma. I wake up early at 6 AM every day. I drink hot green tea and open my windows to let in fresh morning air.
redFlags: ✗ Makes noise early in the morning

pages.bio: After breakfast, I walk in the green park for 30 minutes. I listen to birds sing and say hello to neighbor dogs.
Before I go to sleep, I read a simple book for 15 minutes. I turn off my phone and sleep very peacefully.

daily_habits.opener: Hello! Are you an early morning bird or a late night owl?
daily_habits.prompt: Describe Emma's morning routine, walking habits, and early sleep schedule.

daily_habits.title: Noah
daily_habits.visualDescription: Night owl working on a laptop with soft desk lamp lighting and music headphones.

pages.bio: Hello! I am Noah. I like the night! I stay awake until 1 AM reading or playing games. Quiet nights are peaceful for me.
I go to the gym at 8 PM after dinner. Lifting weights and running on the treadmill keeps me strong and healthy.
Every evening, I write my simple to-do list for tomorrow in a notebook. Organizing my day helps me stay calm.

daily_habits.opener: Hi! Do you prefer going to the gym in the morning or in the evening?
daily_habits.prompt: Talk about Noah's night owl habits, evening gym workout, and daily notebook planning.

appearance.title: Elena
appearance.visualDescription: Athletic woman with shoulder-length wavy auburn hair, hazel eyes, light freckles, wearing a navy blue striped shirt.

pages.bio: I am Elena, 24 years old. I am medium height and active because I exercise every day. I have wavy auburn hair and hazel eyes with light freckles. I like wearing simple striped shirts and jeans.
redFlags: ✗ Hair gets messy in the wind

pages.bio: Every morning I go jogging along the river path. I drink fresh orange juice and eat oats. Staying moving helps me feel happy and productive all afternoon.
I prefer natural looks over heavy makeup. Comfortable clothes make me feel confident. I love bright sunny days when I can spend hours outside!

appearance.opener: Hi! What is your favorite season for casual clothes?
appearance.prompt: Describe Elena's hair, eyes, and clothing style using simple A2 sentences.

appearance.title: Liam
appearance.visualDescription: Tall 6'2" man with neat dark blonde side-part hair and sharp jawline, wearing a tailored navy blazer.

pages.bio: I am Liam, 27 years old. I am tall with short blonde hair and blue eyes. I usually wear well-fitted jackets, dark trousers, and clean leather shoes.
I work in a city bank during the week. In the evening, I enjoy visiting quiet coffee shops with a good newspaper or meeting colleagues for dinner.

appearance.opener: Hello! Do you prefer smart clothes for work or cozy hoodies?
appearance.prompt: How tall is Liam? What does he wear for his job?

professions.title: Nina
professions.visualDescription: Creative designer sitting with a drawing tablet, stylus pen, and colorful art posters.

pages.bio: I am Nina, a graphic designer. I make colorful logos, posters, and websites on my computer. I have dark hair, round glasses, and a creative style.
greenFlags: ✓ Can work from home or cafes
✓ Sees her art in the city

pages.bio: I start my workday with a notebook and sketchpens. I try different color schemes and fonts until the design looks balanced and clear.
Design should be simple, colorful, and helpful for people. I love art galleries, clean typography, and modern city architecture.

professions.opener: Hey! What color combination do you like for a website?
professions.prompt: What tools does Nina use for her work? Why does she like her job?

properties.title: Lucas
properties.visualDescription: Owner of an industrial loft with high concrete ceilings, large glass windows, and kitchen island.

pages.bio: I am Lucas! My flat is a bright one-bedroom loft apartment. It has high ceilings, big industrial windows, and modern white furniture.
I enjoy cooking dinner in the open kitchen while listening to jazz music. Sunlight fills the main room all morning, making it great for plants.

properties.opener: Hi! Do you like big loft apartments with city views?

character.title: Sophia
character.visualDescription: Focused young woman checking off tasks in a paper planner at her clean desk.

pages.bio: I am Sophia. I am organized and always arrive on time because I plan my days with a digital calendar. I like clean spaces and clear rules.
Every Sunday I make a plan for my week. I organize my tasks, prepare healthy meals, and list all my appointments in color-coded files.
Order brings peace to life. When everything is organized, I feel calm and ready to help my family and friends with their goals.

character.opener: Hi! Do you like to plan your week ahead or make quick decisions?
character.prompt: Why is Sophia a reliable friend? Mention two habits she has.

hobbies.title: Hannah
hobbies.visualDescription: Golden loaf of sourdough bread on a wooden cutting board with a knife.

pages.bio: I am Hannah and I love baking bread at home. I mix simple flour, water, and yeast, then bake it in a hot oven until the crust is golden.
Baking requires patience. I knead the dough by hand for ten minutes and let it rise twice. My kitchen smells wonderful when bread is baking.
redFlags: ✗ Wakes up early to knead dough

hobbies.opener: Fresh bread from the oven! Do you prefer butter or olive oil?
hobbies.prompt: What simple ingredients does Hannah use to bake bread?

nationalities.title: Mateo
nationalities.visualDescription: Mexican man in an embroidered shirt holding corn tacos in a town square.

pages.bio: Hola! I am Mateo from Oaxaca, Mexico. I am proud of my country and traditions. We celebrate festivals with colorful flowers, music, and fresh corn tacos.
I work in a local craft market. During breaks, I chat with neighbors and drink traditional chocolate drinks made with cinnamon and hot milk.
Family gatherings are the center of life in Oaxaca. We play guitars, share home-cooked meals, and celebrate life with lots of laughter and dancing.

nationalities.opener: Hola! Do you like spicy food or traditional festivals?
nationalities.prompt: Where is Mateo from? What food does he make at home?

nationalities.title: Freja
nationalities.visualDescription: Danish woman riding a bicycle along Copenhagen harbor in a sweater.

pages.bio: Hej! My name is Freja. I am Danish and I live in Copenhagen, Denmark. In Denmark, we like cozy indoor spaces with candles, soft blankets, and warm drinks.
I ride my bicycle to my university every morning, even when rain or cold wind arrives. We wear warm waterproof coats and ride everywhere together.

nationalities.opener: Hej! Do you like riding bicycles in the city or taking café breaks?
nationalities.prompt: What country is Freja from? How does she travel around her city?

food.title: Chloe
food.visualDescription: Charming pastry enthusiast holding a plate of golden croissants and sweet macaroons outside a bakery.
food.anthem: 🎵 'La Vie en Rose' by Édith Piaf

pages.bio: Hi, I'm Chloe! I work near a French bakery. I buy buttery croissants and fruit tarts every weekend. Baking sweet desserts is my passion.
redFlags: ✗ Spends too much money on cakes

pages.bio: In the morning, I sit at small outdoor cafés with a cappuccino and a warm croissant. I enjoy watching people walk by while eating.
redFlags: ✗ Gets upset if coffee is cold

pages.bio: I love dark chocolate and raspberry macarons. Cooking desserts for my friends brings everyone together on Sunday afternoons.

food.opener: Bonjour! Do you prefer sweet pastries or savory breakfasts in the morning?
food.prompt: Describe Chloe's bakery visits and morning café preferences in simple A2 sentences.

food.title: Carlos
food.visualDescription: Enthusiastic home cook squeezing fresh lime over spicy street tacos at an outdoor grill.

pages.bio: I'm Carlos, 27. Every Saturday I host street taco nights. I grill marinated beef and chicken with fresh cilantro, onions, and lime juice.
I make fresh guacamole with ripe avocados, tomatoes, and garlic. Eating chips and dip with friends while watching football is ideal.
I believe good food needs rich spices and bold flavors. I enjoy discovering food trucks in different neighborhoods across the city.

food.opener: Hey there! How spicy do you like your salsa and tacos?
food.prompt: Write about Carlos's taco nights, fresh ingredients, and love for street food.

travel.title: Mateo
travel.visualDescription: Active hiker wearing a red jacket and backpack standing on a high mountain summit overlooking green valleys.
travel.anthem: 🎵 'I'm Gonna Be (500 Miles)' by The Proclaimers

pages.bio: Hi! I'm Mateo, 26. I love trekking in the mountains on weekends. Fresh air, green pine forests, and rocky trails make me feel active and healthy.
redFlags: ✗ Wakes up at 4 AM to hike

pages.bio: I set up tents near mountain lakes and sleep under the stars. Cooking campfire meals and telling stories at night is my ideal weekend.
I pack warm jackets, water bottles, and reliable hiking boots. Exploring wilderness trails gives me energy for the work week ahead.
redFlags: ✗ No cell phone signal on trips

travel.opener: Hey! Do you prefer hiking up mountains or relaxing in hotel resorts?
travel.prompt: Describe Mateo's hiking adventures, camping trips, and love for nature.

travel.title: Elena
travel.visualDescription: Enthusiastic train traveler sitting by a window seat watching scenic green hills roll past.

pages.bio: Hello! I'm Elena. I prefer taking trains instead of flying. Watching green landscapes pass by the window while listening to music is so peaceful.
I stay in cozy budget hostels and meet travelers from around the world. Sharing travel tips and cooking together in shared kitchens is fun.
When I arrive in a new town, I rent a bicycle and explore local markets, quiet parks, and neighborhood art galleries.

travel.opener: Hi! Do you enjoy long scenic train trips or fast airplane flights?
travel.prompt: Write about Elena's preference for train travel and budget hostel experiences in A2 level.

entertainment.title: Oliver
entertainment.visualDescription: Thoughtful young man wearing large over-ear headphones and holding a vinyl record album in a record shop.

pages.bio: Hi! I'm Oliver, 25. I collect classic vinyl records from vintage music stores. Warm analog sound on a turntable is much better than digital streaming.
I spend cozy rainy evenings reading epic fantasy book series. Immersing myself in magical worlds with dragons and wizards helps me relax.
I love watching science fiction films with space travel and time loops. Discussing movie theories with friends after the film is the best part.

entertainment.opener: Hey! Do you prefer listening to vinyl records or reading fantasy novels?
entertainment.prompt: Write about Oliver's vinyl record collection, reading habits, and sci-fi film discussions.

entertainment.title: Zara
entertainment.visualDescription: Energetic drama fan holding ticket stubs outside a bustling downtown theater.

pages.bio: Hello! I'm Zara. I love live theater and Broadway musicals! Singing along to dramatic soundtrack albums brings so much joy and energy.
I read suspenseful detective mystery books before sleeping. Trying to guess the secret murderer before the final chapter is exciting!
Going to stadium pop concerts with colorful light shows and thousands of cheering fans is my favorite weekend activity.

entertainment.opener: Hi! Do you like live stage musicals or solving detective mystery books?
entertainment.prompt: Describe Zara's passion for theater musicals, mystery novels, and live pop concerts.

daily_habits.title: Chloe
daily_habits.visualDescription: Serene yoga practitioner sitting on a mat doing morning stretching in a bright room with houseplants.

pages.bio: Hi, I'm Chloe! Every morning at 7 AM I do 20 minutes of yoga and gentle stretching on my mat. Starting the day with deep breathing keeps me calm and focused.
redFlags: ✗ Yoga mat takes up room space

pages.bio: For breakfast, I blend fresh spinach, banana, almond milk, and chia seeds. Eating healthy whole foods gives me lasting energy throughout my workday.
redFlags: ✗ Spends a lot on organic chia

pages.bio: Before sleeping, I write three things I am grateful for in my gratitude journal. Focusing on positive moments helps me sleep peacefully.

daily_habits.opener: Bonjour! Do you practice daily morning stretching or do you prefer a hot cup of coffee first?
daily_habits.prompt: Describe Chloe's morning yoga routine, healthy smoothie habits, and nightly journaling.

daily_habits.title: Ethan
daily_habits.visualDescription: Organized young professional checking a smartwatch while preparing a meal-prep container.

pages.bio: Hello! I'm Ethan, 26. I love structure and time management! I schedule my daily tasks using calendar apps and set reminders to stay organized.
On Sunday afternoons, I cook healthy meals for the entire work week. Storing portioned containers of chicken, rice, and vegetables saves time and money.
redFlags: ✗ Eats same lunch 5 days in a row

pages.bio: I turn off all phone notifications after 8 PM every evening. Spending two hours screen-free reading or walking helps me rest my mind.

daily_habits.opener: Hi! Do you like organizing your week with meal prep or eating spontaneously?
daily_habits.prompt: Write about Ethan's time management, weekly meal prep routine, and digital detox habits.

appearance.title: Maya
appearance.visualDescription: Artistic woman with voluminous dark brown curly hair and expressive dark eyes, wearing an embroidered bohemian kimono.
appearance.anthem: 🎵 'Dog Days Are Over' by Florence + The Machine

pages.bio: I'm Maya, a 26-year-old artist. I have dark brown curly hair, dark eyes, and a warm smile. I like wearing bohemian clothes, long skirts, and handmade bracelets because they match my creative personality.
redFlags: ✗ Takes a long time to style her hair

pages.bio: I spend my afternoons in a sunlit art studio, mixing watercolor paints and listening to indie music. My clothes often have small paint spots, which I consider badges of honor.
redFlags: ✗ Loses track of time while painting

pages.bio: I believe art should express authentic emotions rather than perfect technical rules. I enjoy exploring flea markets for vintage clothes and old picture frames that tell stories.

appearance.opener: Hey! Do your clothes show your personality or do you wear whatever is comfortable?
appearance.prompt: Describe Maya's appearance and explain how her clothes show her style.

appearance.title: Julian
appearance.visualDescription: Broad-shouldered man with a trimmed dark beard and short undercut hair, wearing a heavy flannel plaid shirt.
appearance.anthem: 🎵 'Take Me Home, Country Roads' by John Denver

pages.bio: I'm Julian, a 29-year-old who loves spending time outdoors. I'm tall with a short dark beard and hazel eyes. I usually wear comfortable flannel shirts and sturdy boots because I like hiking on weekends.
On Saturday mornings, I pack my backpack with trail mix and a compass to explore national park trails. I enjoy fresh pine air and camping under starry night skies.
redFlags: ✗ Wakes up at 4:30 AM for sunrise hikes
✗ No phone signal on mountain trails
✗ Muddy boots near the front door

appearance.opener: Hi! Do you like a casual outdoor style or a neat office look?
appearance.prompt: Describe Julian's look and explain why his clothes suit his outdoor hobbies.

professions.title: Marcus
professions.visualDescription: Software engineer working at a dual-monitor standing desk, wearing noise-canceling headphones.

pages.bio: I'm Marcus, a software developer. I build websites and phone apps that help people organize their work. My job includes writing code, fixing computer bugs, and working in a team with other programmers.
redFlags: ✗ Sitting at a desk for long hours

pages.bio: My workday revolves around daily team standup meetings, writing clean code, and testing software features. When a difficult bug appears, solving it feels like winning a puzzle game.
redFlags: ✗ Drinks 4 cups of coffee per day

pages.bio: Technology should make human lives simpler rather than more complicated. I prefer open-source software projects and apps that respect user privacy.

professions.opener: Hello! Would you like to work in technology and software development?
professions.prompt: What does Marcus do every day in his job as a software developer?

professions.title: Clara
professions.visualDescription: Journalist holding a recording microphone, interviewing an engineer near wind turbines.
professions.anthem: 🎵 'Blowin' in the Wind' by Bob Dylan

pages.bio: I'm Clara, a news reporter who writes articles about the environment. I travel to interview scientists and report on solar power and clean energy projects. I love my job because I share important news with the public.
greenFlags: ✓ Travels to interesting places for stories

pages.bio: One day I'm interviewing marine biologists on a coastal boat, and the next day I'm writing articles in a noisy newsroom. I always carry two audio recorders and a waterproof notebook.
redFlags: ✗ Phone constantly buzzing with news alerts

professions.opener: Hi! What environmental news or clean energy topic interests you most?
professions.prompt: Explain what Clara does as a news reporter and why her job is important.

properties.title: Arthur
properties.visualDescription: Historic paper mill converted into a luxury loft with exposed red brick, heavy timber beams, and river views.

pages.bio: I'm Arthur. I live in a two-bedroom apartment inside an old restored paper factory. It has exposed red brick walls, large wooden beams, and big windows looking over the river.
greenFlags: ✓ Great river view from the window
redFlags: ✗ High ceilings are hard to heat

pages.bio: The open space is decorated with industrial metal lamps and vintage wooden furniture. In the evening, river currents reflect soft city lights across the ceiling.
redFlags: ✗ Echoes if music is turned up loud

pages.bio: I value buildings that preserve their history instead of tearing down old walls. Living in a space with character makes daily life feel grounded and inspiring.

properties.opener: Welcome! Do you like living in old renovated buildings or modern new flats?
icebreakers: A quiet house with a garden!
properties.prompt: Describe Arthur's apartment and list two good things and two bad things about it.

character.title: Daniel
character.visualDescription: Warm-hearted man listening intently during a conversation at a quiet coffee shop.

pages.bio: I'm Daniel, 28. I am a helpful person who listens carefully when friends have problems. I try to understand people's feelings and give thoughtful advice when they ask for help.
redFlags: ✗ Needs quiet time alone after long chats

pages.bio: I prefer deep one-on-one conversations over loud group parties. I regularly call old friends to check on them and remember small details about their lives.
redFlags: ✗ Gets exhausted by large social gatherings

character.opener: Hello! When you make decisions, do you follow logical thinking or your feelings?
character.prompt: Why is Daniel a good friend? Describe his personality traits.

hobbies.title: Ethan
hobbies.visualDescription: Climber wearing chalk bag, gripping indoor bouldering holds on an overhang wall.

pages.bio: I'm Ethan. Bouldering is my main hobby. I climb short indoor walls without ropes, using chalk on my hands to grip the holds. It gives me a great workout and helps me practice focus and problem solving.
I spend three evenings a week at the local climbing gym analyzing route angles with gym buddies. Working out a difficult climbing sequence feels like solving a physical riddle.
My goal for next summer is outdoor bouldering in granite canyons. Being outdoors surrounded by rock faces and nature tests your physical limits in the best way.
redFlags: ✗ Weekend trips revolve only around rocks

hobbies.opener: Hey! Have you ever tried indoor rock climbing or bouldering?
hobbies.prompt: Explain why Ethan likes bouldering and what equipment he uses.

nationalities.title: Amara
nationalities.visualDescription: Nigerian woman wearing a patterned Ankara headwrap and traditional attire in Lagos.

pages.bio: Kedu! I'm Amara from Lagos, Nigeria. Nigeria has many cultural groups, lively Afrobeats music, and great food. We love getting together with family to eat spicy Jollof rice and listen to music.
greenFlags: ✓ Hosts fun dinners with great music
redFlags: ✗ Long debates about who cooks the best rice

pages.bio: Lagos is an energetic city that never sleeps. I love visiting colorful fabric markets, dancing to Afrobeats at weekend celebrations, and cooking rich stews for friends.
redFlags: ✗ Music always turned to maximum volume
✗ Debates Jollof rice recipes for hours

nationalities.opener: Kedu! Do you like trying spicy foods or listening to music from other countries?
icebreakers: I listen to music from everywhere!
nationalities.prompt: Describe Amara's country and food traditions using simple B1 sentences.

nationalities.title: Aarav
nationalities.visualDescription: Indian man in a blue kurta near Jaipur monuments holding cardamom chai.

pages.bio: Namaste! I'm Aarav from Jaipur, India. India is famous for colorful festivals, ancient palaces, and delicious spices. In Indian culture, welcoming guests is very important. I drink warm cardamom tea every morning.
greenFlags: ✓ Knows how to cook with rich spices

pages.bio: I work in textile design, preserving traditional block-printing patterns passed down through generations. Every morning starts with fresh spiced chai brewed with real ginger and cardamom.
redFlags: ✗ Gets passionate about cricket match umpire decisions

pages.bio: 'Atithi Devo Bhava' means the guest is like God in our culture. Hosting friends for home-cooked thali dinners with aromatic spices brings me immense satisfaction.

nationalities.opener: Namaste! Have you ever tasted Indian food or visited historical monuments?
nationalities.prompt: Describe Aarav's home city and cultural traditions.

food.title: Amina
food.visualDescription: Warm home cook serving fragrant tagine stew seasoned with saffron and almonds from a clay vessel.

pages.bio: I'm Amina, 28. I specialize in slow-cooked Moroccan tagines with chickpeas, tender lamb, apricot, and cinnamon. Slow cooking brings out deep, comforting flavors that warm the soul.
I frequently visit local spice markets to source authentic saffron, cumin, and cardamom. Combining unusual savory and sweet elements creates memorable dining experiences.
After dinner, I serve sweet fresh mint tea poured high into decorative glasses. Food is meant to be a slow, shared celebration rather than a rushed daily chore.
redFlags: ✗ Tea has a lot of sugar

food.opener: Hello! Do you prefer quick 15-minute meals or slow-cooked dishes with complex spices?
food.prompt: Discuss Amina's approach to slow cooking and how spices elevate meal experiences.

food.title: Liam
food.visualDescription: Health-conscious farm-to-table enthusiast preparing a colorful organic Buddha bowl with quinoa and avocado.

pages.bio: I'm Liam, 29. I advocate for sustainable farm-to-table eating. My kitchen is filled with colorful bowls of quinoa, roasted sweet potatoes, kale, and homemade tahini dressing.
I grow my own heirloom tomatoes, basil, and microgreens in a community garden plot. Eating produce harvested just an hour prior completely changes your perspective on food.
My mornings start with a nutrient-dense spinach, ginger, and spirulina smoothie. Staying healthy gives me boundless energy for outdoor hiking weekend trips.

food.opener: Hi! Are you interested in plant-based organic food or traditional comfort meals?
food.prompt: Explain Liam's farm-to-table philosophy and the benefits of organic plant-based diets.

travel.title: Diego
travel.visualDescription: Adventurous solo traveler with a large backpack standing at a bustling crossroad in Southeast Asia.
travel.film: 🎬 'The Secret Life of Walter Mitty' (Ben Stiller)

pages.bio: I'm Diego, 28. For three years I've worked remotely while backpacking through South America and Asia. Solo travel forces you out of your comfort zone and builds deep confidence.
redFlags: ✗ Rarely stays in one place long

pages.bio: Rather than visiting crowded tourist traps, I stay with local families, learn basic regional phrases, and participate in traditional cooking workshops.
Balancing laptop work from beach cafés with weekend jungle treks requires self-discipline, reliable Wi-Fi, and a flexible mind.

travel.opener: Hey! Could you imagine working remotely while backpacking around the world?
travel.prompt: Analyze Diego's digital nomad lifestyle and the rewards of solo backpacking.

travel.title: Freja
travel.visualDescription: Nordic traveler in a cozy wool sweater watching glowing green Northern Lights in a snowy Arctic landscape.

pages.bio: I'm Freja, 27. I have a passion for cold-climate destinations—chasing the Northern Lights in Lapland, dog sledding across fjords, and staying in wooden wilderness cabins.
Nothing compares to plunging into a cold lake after a traditional wood-fired sauna, followed by hot berry juice beside a roaring fireplace.
Photographing auroras and constellations beneath crisp Arctic night skies requires patience, tripod setups, and sub-zero thermal gear.

travel.opener: Hello! Would you rather chase the Northern Lights in winter or sunbathe on a tropical island?
travel.prompt: Discuss Freja's Arctic expedition interests and Scandinavian sauna traditions.

entertainment.title: Felix
entertainment.visualDescription: Film student holding a classic 35mm film camera in front of an independent arthouse cinema marquee.

pages.bio: I'm Felix, 27. I'm deeply passionate about independent cinema and classic European director retrospectives. Subtitled foreign films offer profound glimpses into diverse human conditions.
My bookshelf is filled with 19th-century literature and philosophical essays. Analyzing character motivations and thematic symbolism enriches my worldview.
redFlags: ✗ Judges people by their reading list

pages.bio: I listen to instrumental jazz and orchestral film scores while writing script analyses. Music should evoke subtle mood atmospheres rather than loud repetitive hooks.

entertainment.opener: Hello! Do you prefer independent foreign cinema or mainstream Hollywood movies?
entertainment.prompt: Discuss Felix's appreciation for arthouse cinema, classic literature, and film score music.

entertainment.title: Nadia
entertainment.visualDescription: Podcast host wearing studio headphones speaking into a professional microphone.

pages.bio: I'm Nadia, 26. I produce an investigative crime podcast. Unraveling real-life mysteries, psychological motives, and historical cold cases completely fascinates me.
redFlags: ✗ Listens to crime stories while falling asleep
✗ Suspects plot twists in real life

pages.bio: I consume audiobooks during daily commutes and long walks. Listening to professional voice actors narrate gripping biographies turns mundane travel into immersive journeys.
Acoustic indie folk with poetic lyrics and harmonious vocals is my comfort genre. Attending intimate acoustic house shows is my favorite weekend outing.

entertainment.opener: Hi! Are you hooked on true crime podcasts or do you prefer fiction audiobooks?
entertainment.prompt: Explain Nadia's podcasting interests, audiobook consumption habits, and indie folk musical taste.

daily_habits.title: Sora
daily_habits.visualDescription: Minimalist carrying reusable cotton totes and glass jars at a zero-waste neighborhood bulk shop.

pages.bio: I'm Sora, 27. I practice a zero-waste lifestyle by shopping with reusable cloth bags and glass jars at bulk stores. Small daily choices collectively make a massive environmental impact.
I follow minimalist principles in my home environment. Owning fewer possessions reduces mental clutter and allows me to focus on meaningful experiences rather than material things.
I commute to work by bicycle year-round regardless of weather. Pedaling through urban streets keeps me physically fit while eliminating my transportation carbon footprint.

daily_habits.opener: Hello! Have you ever attempted a zero-waste challenge or embraced minimalist living?
daily_habits.prompt: Discuss Sora's commitment to zero-waste habits, minimalism, and eco-friendly commuting.

daily_habits.title: Marcus
daily_habits.visualDescription: Marathon runner lacing up running shoes at dawn on a misty riverfront track.

pages.bio: I'm Marcus, 29. I train for long-distance marathons by running 15 kilometers every morning at 5:30 AM. Developing physical endurance builds mental resilience for life's challenges.
redFlags: ✗ Wakes up at 5 AM every single day

pages.bio: I take a 2-minute ice-cold shower every morning after running. It boosts circulation, sharpens focus, and instantly dispels morning sluggishness.
redFlags: ✗ Tries to convince everyone to try cold showers

pages.bio: I log my daily water intake, sleep hours, and running mileage in a habit tracking app. Seeing unbroken consistency streaks motivates me to push further.

daily_habits.opener: Hi! Do you thrive on strict disciplined routines or prefer a flexible, spontaneous day?
daily_habits.prompt: Analyze Marcus's marathon training discipline, cold shower habit, and habit tracking.

appearance.title: Victoria
appearance.visualDescription: Statuesque 5'10" woman with a razor-sharp platinum blonde bob, piercing ice-blue eyes, high cheekbones, wearing an asymmetrical blazer.

pages.bio: I'm Victoria, 29. I'm 5'10" with ice-blue eyes and a short platinum blonde bob. I love clean, simple high-fashion outfits that look modern and stylish.
Working as a luxury brand coordinator requires impeccable presentation. I curate structured monochromatic wardrobes that project authority and elegance in executive boardrooms.
True style isn't about chasing transient trends, but rather discovering timeless silhouettes that reflect inner discipline and refined artistic taste.
redFlags: ✗ Can come across as overly critical

appearance.opener: Hi! How much does someone's outfit influence your first impression of them?
appearance.prompt: Talk about Victoria's style and how clothing choices shape first impressions.

appearance.title: Gabriel
appearance.visualDescription: Charismatic 34-year-old man with distinguished silver-templed dark hair and captivating dimples, wearing a tailored charcoal wool coat.

pages.bio: I'm Gabriel, 34. I'm 6'0" tall with silver-templed dark hair, hazel eyes, and a friendly smile. I prefer classic, tailored coats and timeless European style over fast fashion.
redFlags: ✗ Takes a long time styling silver hair

pages.bio: I begin mornings with espresso while reading international architectural journals. My wardrobe consists of handmade wool coats, polished leather loafers, and vintage mechanical watches.

appearance.opener: Hello! Do you prefer keeping up with modern trends or sticking to classic clothing styles?
appearance.prompt: Discuss how Gabriel's classic clothing and mature look give him a charismatic appearance.

professions.title: Dr. Aris
professions.visualDescription: Researcher auditing algorithmic bias charts on transparent displays in a university research laboratory.

pages.bio: I'm Dr. Aris, a technology ethics researcher. I test artificial intelligence programs to prevent bias, protect user privacy, and make sure new tech is fair. I also help write clear policy guidelines for tech companies.
greenFlags: ✓ Working on important modern tech issues
✓ Helps protect user privacy and fairness
redFlags: ✗ Complicated rules with no easy answers

pages.bio: My daily schedule involves reviewing algorithmic fairness metrics, speaking at academic conferences, and consulting with legal committees on digital rights and automated decision-making.
Artificial intelligence should serve humanity with accountability and transparency. Technology without ethical boundaries risks compounding societal inequality.

professions.opener: Hi! Should governments regulate artificial intelligence, or should tech companies decide for themselves?
professions.prompt: Discuss the pros and cons of setting clear ethical rules for artificial intelligence.

professions.title: Soren
professions.visualDescription: Architect examining intricate stonework details of a historic cathedral during a restoration project.

pages.bio: I'm Soren, an architect who specializes in restoring old buildings. I renovate historical structures so they can be used as modern apartments or offices without losing their original character.
greenFlags: ✓ Protects historical architecture for the community
✓ Combines classic style with eco-friendly features
redFlags: ✗ Slow approval processes with local councils

pages.bio: I spend half my week on dusty construction sites inspecting century-old masonry and timber, and the other half drafting sustainable retrofitting plans using modern insulation.
redFlags: ✗ Comes home with brick dust on shoes

professions.opener: Hello! How can cities preserve their historical buildings while building new housing and transport?
professions.prompt: Talk about the challenges Soren faces when trying to renovate historic buildings for modern use.

properties.title: Xavier
properties.visualDescription: Luxury penthouse terrace featuring a private glass-edge infinity pool, 360-degree skyline panoramas, and smart automation.

pages.bio: I'm Xavier. My penthouse apartment sits on the top floor of Pinnacle Tower. It features a private glass-edge pool, 360-degree city views, and smart home controls for lights and security.
greenFlags: ✓ Amazing panoramic views of the city

pages.bio: Living 50 floors above the metropolis offers breathtaking sunsets and serene quietness above urban traffic. Automated climate controls and minimalist floor-to-ceiling glass define the space.
redFlags: ✗ High wind noise during winter storms

pages.bio: I view architecture as elevated sanctuary. Having a peaceful refuge high above the bustle allows me to recharge, host intimate gatherings, and maintain strategic focus.

properties.opener: Welcome! Would you enjoy living high above the city in a luxury penthouse?
icebreakers: I prefer living on the ground!
properties.prompt: Describe what it would be like to live in Xavier's penthouse and discuss the pros and cons.

character.title: Helena
character.visualDescription: Determined female executive standing on a terrace overlooking the city skyline.

pages.bio: I'm Helena, 32. I'm a business manager focused on long-term strategy, staying calm under pressure, and supporting my team. I treat mistakes as useful lessons to help us improve next time.
greenFlags: ✓ Stays calm and focused during crises

pages.bio: I lead cross-functional teams through complex corporate turnarounds. My management style combines empathetic listening with rigorous performance accountability.
redFlags: ✗ Hard time switching off work mode

character.opener: Hello! What qualities do you think make someone a truly effective leader?
character.prompt: Discuss Helena's leadership style and explain what traits make a good team leader.

hobbies.title: Felix
hobbies.visualDescription: Vintage 35mm film camera resting on a darkroom wooden bench next to developed negatives.

pages.bio: I'm Felix. I shoot analog photos with a 35mm film camera. You only get 36 shots per roll and cannot check the photo immediately, so you have to be patient and focus on lighting and composition before developing negatives in the darkroom.
greenFlags: ✓ Real physical photo prints to keep
redFlags: ✗ Accidental light leaks can ruin photos

pages.bio: I convert my bathroom into a makeshift darkroom on Sunday afternoons. Mixing developer chemicals and watching silver-halide images emerge on photographic paper under red light is pure magic.
greenFlags: ✓ Master of classic analog darkroom chemistry

pages.bio: In an era of disposable digital media where people take thousands of forgotten smartphone photos, analog film forces you to slow down, respect light, and cherish single moments.
redFlags: ✗ Refuses to take quick selfie photos

hobbies.opener: Hi! Do you prefer taking fast photos on a smartphone or taking time with traditional film?
icebreakers: I like a bit of both!
hobbies.prompt: Compare smartphone photography with traditional film photography based on Felix's hobby.

nationalities.title: Camille
nationalities.visualDescription: French woman in a trench coat seated at a Parisian pavement café with wine.
nationalities.anthem: 🎵 'La Vie en rose' by Édith Piaf

pages.bio: Bonjour! I'm Camille from Paris. In France, we value enjoying life through good food, art, and long discussions over dinner. I love exploring Parisian cafes, fresh pastries, and local markets.
greenFlags: ✓ Great knowledge of food and cheese
redFlags: ✗ Sighs if the coffee isn't hot enough
✗ Always compares food to French cuisine

pages.bio: My morning starts with a fresh crispy baguette from the neighborhood boulangerie. On weekends, I browse contemporary art exhibits at the Palais de Tokyo before enjoying wine with friends.
redFlags: ✗ Refuses day-old bread under any condition

nationalities.opener: Bonjour! How much do food and cultural traditions influence your daily life?
icebreakers: Food is a huge part of culture!
nationalities.prompt: Discuss French lifestyle and food traditions as described in Camille's profile.

nationalities.title: Leandro
nationalities.visualDescription: Brazilian man playing beach volleyball on Ipanema Beach in Rio de Janeiro.
nationalities.anthem: 🎵 'The Girl from Ipanema' by Stan Getz & Astrud Gilberto

pages.bio: Olá! I'm Leandro from Rio de Janeiro. Brazil is a vibrant country rich in music, beach sports, and outdoor gatherings. From bossa nova melodies to lively weekend barbecues, community and music are at the heart of daily life.
greenFlags: ✓ Plays acoustic guitar and bossa nova
redFlags: ✗ Plays music late into the night

pages.bio: I spend weekends playing footvolley on Ipanema beach, strumming samba chords on my nylon-string guitar, and preparing slow-cooked feijoada for big gatherings of family and friends.
Music in Brazil isn't just entertainment; it's our collective language for processing joy and saudade. Gathering people around rhythm and good food creates lifelong bonds.
redFlags: ✗ Cannot stand quiet solitary silence for long

nationalities.opener: Olá! What comes to mind when you think about Brazilian music and culture?
icebreakers: I love lively music and food!
nationalities.prompt: Talk about how music and social gatherings shape daily life in Brazil according to Leandro.

food.title: Antoine
food.visualDescription: Sophisticated sommelier swirling a glass of Burgundy wine in an elegant dimly-lit fine dining restaurant.

pages.bio: I'm Antoine, 31, a certified sommelier and culinary critic. I view gastronomy as an intricate art form where delicate flavor profiles, wine pairings, and ambient aesthetics harmonize to evoke emotion.

In my spare time, I experiment with molecular gastronomy, sous-vide precision temperature cooking, and artisanal emulsifications. Cooking requires meticulous discipline and respect for raw ingredients.
redFlags: ✗ Spends 3 hours plating a single dish

pages.bio: I frequent small regional producers in France and Italy to source unpasteurized raw-milk cheeses, truffle oils, and rare heritage grains that preserve authentic culinary heritage.
redFlags: ✗ Hard to please at dinner parties

food.opener: Greetings! Do you evaluate meals based on nostalgic comfort or refined gastronomic technique?
food.prompt: Evaluate Antoine's perspective on fine dining, wine pairing, and molecular gastronomy.

food.title: Siddharth
food.visualDescription: Innovative fusion chef tossing aromatic spices in a flaming wok, combining Indian and pan-Asian flavors.

pages.bio: I'm Siddharth, 30. As a modern fusion chef, I synthesize traditional Indian spice layering with contemporary Japanese and Nordic culinary methodologies, reimagining classic recipes for modern palates.
My culinary philosophy centers on smoke, acidity, and umami balance. Utilizing high-heat tandoor ovens alongside wok-searing allows me to achieve extraordinary textural contrasts.
While I embrace modern innovation, my foundation relies on ancient spice-roasting techniques passed down through generations. Honoring tradition while breaking rules defines true creativity.

food.opener: Hello! Do you prefer respecting traditional regional recipes or exploring bold culinary fusion?
food.prompt: Analyze Siddharth's fusion philosophy and how he balances tradition with culinary innovation.

travel.title: Sebastian
travel.visualDescription: Experienced sailor steering a white sailboat through deep blue waters along a rugged Mediterranean coastline.

pages.bio: I'm Sebastian, 32, a licensed skipper and oceanography enthusiast. Navigating open marine waters using wind currents and celestial navigation offers an unparalleled sense of elemental freedom.
I specialize in charting remote island archipelagoes in the Aegean and Adriatic seas, dropping anchor in secluded coves unreachable by overland transit.
Standing night watch at the helm beneath bioluminescent waters and open starry horizons cultivates a profound reverence for ocean ecosystems and self-reliance.

travel.opener: Greetings! Do you find open-ocean sailing exhilarating or intimidating?
travel.prompt: Examine Sebastian's nautical expertise, open-water navigation, and ocean conservancy.

travel.title: Camille
travel.visualDescription: Cultural anthropologist writing in a journal beside ancient ruins at an archaeological site.

pages.bio: I'm Camille, 30. As an architectural historian, my travel philosophy prioritizes heritage preservation, sustainable eco-tourism, and critical engagement with historical narratives.
I document endangered architectural craft traditions across Central Asia and the Mediterranean, advocating for community-led tourism models that protect indigenous heritage.
Minimizing carbon footprints by utilizing electric overland transit and supporting locally owned eco-lodges ensures tourism benefits host communities directly.
redFlags: ✗ Strict carbon audit of travel plans

travel.opener: Hello! How do you balance tourist enjoyment with ethical cultural preservation when traveling?
travel.prompt: Evaluate Camille's views on sustainable tourism, historical preservation, and responsible travel.

entertainment.title: Julian
entertainment.visualDescription: Orchestral conductor studying a complex musical score with a baton in hand.

pages.bio: I'm Julian, 31, an assistant conductor and musicologist. Analyzing polyphonic counterpoint and orchestrating complex harmonic movements requires rigorous intellectual precision and emotional sensitivity.
redFlags: ✗ Highly critical of minor pitch errors

pages.bio: I study comparative literature, exploring narrative structural parallels between 20th-century modernist novels and symphonic movement forms.
I revere auteur filmmakers who utilize minimalist soundscapes and long unedited takes to examine psychological isolation and moral ambiguity.

entertainment.opener: Greetings! Does classical symphonic structure feel transcendent or overly formal to you?
icebreakers: A bit too formal for me!
entertainment.prompt: Critique Julian's musical philosophy, literature comparative studies, and auteur film tastes.

entertainment.title: Sienna
entertainment.visualDescription: Interactive narrative designer sitting before multi-screen game development software and concept art.

pages.bio: I'm Sienna, 29, a narrative designer for story-driven video games. I craft branching plotlines where player agency shapes complex ethical dilemmas and emotional character arcs.
I devour cyberpunk, dystopian, and speculative fiction literature. World-building that examines technological ethics and human identity inspires my creative projects.
Synthesizer soundscapes and ambient electronic beats form the soundtrack to my creative design sessions, evoking futuristic urban atmospheres.

entertainment.opener: Hello! Do you believe interactive video games can achieve the same narrative depth as classic novels?
entertainment.prompt: Evaluate Sienna's role as an interactive narrative designer and speculative fiction enthusiast.

daily_habits.title: Valerie
daily_habits.visualDescription: Focused executive practicing deep work techniques at a minimal wooden desk with an hourglass.

pages.bio: I'm Valerie, 30. As a strategy consultant, I structure my workday around uninterrupted 90-minute 'deep work' blocks, eliminating notifications to maximize cognitive output and flow state.
I optimize my circadian rhythm by getting direct sunlight exposure within 15 minutes of waking, delaying caffeine intake by two hours, and using dim red light spectrums before sleep.
Every evening I practice Stoic journaling, reflecting on what was within my control and mentally rehearsing potential challenges for the upcoming day to cultivate emotional tranquility.

daily_habits.opener: Greetings! Do you design your daily habits around scientific biohacking or intuitive flexibility?
daily_habits.prompt: Evaluate Valerie's deep work methodologies, circadian rhythm optimization, and Stoic philosophy.

daily_habits.title: Gabriel
daily_habits.visualDescription: Artistic polymath sketching ideas in a leather journal at a sunlit wooden table surrounded by plants.
daily_habits.anthem: 🎵 'Rivers and Roads' by The Head and the Heart

pages.bio: I'm Gabriel, 32. I embrace a slow-living lifestyle that intentionally resists hyper-productivity culture, choosing instead to savor contemplative morning espresso rituals and artisanal craftsmanship.
Rather than rigid schedules, my routines adapt fluidly to seasonal cycles and creative moods—focusing on writing in autumn and outdoor woodworking during summer months.
redFlags: ✗ Hard to fix exact meeting times

pages.bio: My evenings involve candlelit dinners, vinyl listening sessions, and manual fountain pen journaling—fostering authentic tactile connections in an increasingly digitized society.

daily_habits.opener: Hello! Do you lean toward optimizing daily efficiency or embracing the art of slow, seasonal living?
daily_habits.prompt: Analyze Gabriel's slow living philosophy, polymorphic routines, and tactile evening rituals.
